description: Replication code for "Crop farm efficiency and climate extremes in Germany" published at European Review of Agricultural Economics by Moritz Hartig, Silke Hüttel, and Stefan Seifert. Find the full replication package here: https://github.com/mohartig/Crop_farm_efficiency_and_climate_extremes_in_Germany The data used for this study is under data protection regulations and cannot be published or shared by the authors. For any questions on the data, please contact Moritz Hartig: moritz.hartig@icloud.com
